description: Pre-distribution gate implementing the VISUAL-ASSET REVIEW Ground Zero invariant. Finds all image-bearing components in campaign.json and BLOCKs distribution if campaign.review.assets_reviewed is not true. A vision-capable reviewer must inspect each asset at full resolution before this field may be set.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=assets reviewed or no images, exit 1=BLOCK (image-bearing components without review), exit 2=WARN (unreadable).

files.HOW.py: Visual review gate — check assets_reviewed=true before allowing image-bearing campaign to distribute
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past distributions with unreviewed assets
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal review_skipped if block rate exceeds 15%

how_to_pass: Set campaign.review.assets_reviewed=true after a vision-capable reviewer (human or GPT-4V/Gemini Vision) inspects each asset file at full resolution and confirms: text not clipped, safe-zone observed, correct campaign, correct dimensions.
origin_incident: 2026-04-23 jury-beats-judge Part-2: three rounds of image text-clipping caught only after broken files were attached to live LinkedIn posts. Gate built to enforce VISUAL-ASSET REVIEW invariant.
